messages.snippet: Dear Julia, For the Caldera licence we need your freedom-to-operate confirmation on the QX-Clock fam
messages.subject: QX-Clock - FTO confirmation for licence
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Julia,

For the Caldera licence we need your freedom-to-operate confirmation on the QX-Clock family, in particular any third-party rights of relevance to QX-2 (the vapour-cell patent). Could you confirm your opinion in time for our disclosure letter (target 22 January signing)?

Kind regards,
Elena

Elena Marchetti
Associate | Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ

messages.subject: RE: QX-Clock - FTO confirmation for licence
messages.plaintextBody:
Elena,

Our FTO opinion is issued today. One European patent held by an unrelated vapour-cell supplier is of potential relevance to QX-2, but in our view the Licensed Products do not infringe it. Formal opinion to follow for Appendix 3 of your disclosure letter.

Julia Hartington | Hartington IP
